environment: Google Apps Script, bound to Google Sheets
source: Sanitized CFProviderReportJson execution-log export after rerunning Google Finance website, Yahoo Finance website and Globe & Mail

carried_forward.note: These providers were not rerun. Saved response fields match the previous combined report; the native JSON export redacts endpoint URLs.

limitations: Provider-specific reruns reuse the report run ID; Retrieved UTC identifies the new response times.
PARSED establishes extraction, not independent financial accuracy or complete ticker coverage.
The captured public Google Finance XIC page omits yield; the native Apps Script lookup still reports MISSING_VALUE.
Google and Yahoo HTML quote timestamps remain unknown. Globe raw tradeTime is a quote timestamp, not a yield publication date.
Yahoo stock yields use Forward Dividend & Yield; Globe stock yields use dividendYieldTrailing. ETF/fund rows use provider yield or distribution fields.
All source fixtures contain public excerpts; API keys and private Google project identifiers are excluded.
